rationale: Third-party minor sustained bodily injury (broken wrist) on policyholder's property, with parents seeking medical expense recovery—classic premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped on policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm and sustained a broken wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bill reimbursement. Pediatric fracture requires prompt adjuster contact to coordinate medical documentation and evaluate premises liability exposure.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway
